    "Model forecasts are systematically below true prices for first 10-15 days, showing significant lag that gradually closes as forecast horizon extends",
    "Sentiment turning positive (1.00) correlates with faster price recovery and higher lows than model predicts",
    "Model underestimates price volatility in first 15 days, with true prices showing more extreme swings than forecasts",
    "Beyond day 20 in the forecast horizon, model forecasts become too conservative, underpricing peaks by 3-6 euros",
    "Mean reversion bias in model: forecasts move too slowly from initial daily prices, especially when history shows strong trends",
    "High sentiment (1.00) in history accelerates convergence between model and true prices in the near term",
    "When history price is at a local minimum, model fails to forecast the quick rebound that actually occurs"
